title: Mysterious Arcane Shop Window
description: A nighttime view through a large arched shop window reveals a purple anthropomorphic lizard wizard standing behind a counter. The interior is filled with glowing magical lanterns, an open spellbook, framed arcane paintings, and shelves of potions, while rain falls on the dark cobblestone street outside.
prompt: A nighttime fantasy scene viewed through a large arched shop window on a rainy cobblestone street. Inside, a purple anthropomorphic lizard wizard wearing ornate robes and a high collar stands behind a counter, holding a glowing green orb. The shop is filled with hanging colorful magical lanterns, an open ancient spellbook, framed paintings of galaxies and glowing trees, potion bottles, and mystical artifacts. Warm light spills out into the wet street. Detailed digital painting with rich atmosphere.
